required_roles.case_pack: drawn cases, strata, provenance, seed, frame commit and frame sha256
required_roles.label_packet: the blind packet the user labelled, with the frozen labelling rules
required_roles.labels: the user's blind labels (label and claim type per case), each in the packet's label_record contract
required_roles.relabels: the seeded 15% re-labels, written at least 24 hours later and before any model call, in the same record contract
required_roles.promptfoo_tests: the generated test rows (case_id, repeat_index, source, claim, arm_group): the bytes p1_casepack.py tests writes from the pack, the labels' native repeats and three local repeats
required_roles.rendered_inputs: sha256 of the exact bytes per case and arm input, after the A2 pass: the native prompt (O, S, G), the jev-state prompt (L) and each J provider's HTTP request body
required_roles.render_check: promptfoo output reproducing every rendered input with no model call: the echo provider for the prompts, loopback copies of the J providers for the request bodies
required_roles.harness: promptfoo config, prompts (question text and option orders), provider adapters
required_roles.draw_and_scoring_code: frame extractor, case pack, scoring code and its hash-locked requirements
required_roles.native_launch_contexts: hash of each native arm's init event (O, S, G) from the smoke checks
required_roles.arm_l_checkpoint: arm L checkpoint name, full revision and file hashes
required_roles.a2_custody: each A2 result the case pack records, in pass order: item i is the original result of a2_passes[i], whose canonical sha256 is that pass's result_sha256 (gitleaks 8.30.1, the host-path and identity rule and the home-directory and user-name canary over the exact bytes)
required_roles.canary: the A1 canary: 10 frozen cases and their stored answers

draft_checks.render_check_method: render-check.yaml: the echo provider for the prompts and loopback copies of the J providers for the request bodies, in a network namespace with only loopback; no model call
